name: Mould History
query:
SELECT
    m.name AS "Mould No:Link/Mould:200",
    m.mould_type AS "Mould Type:Data:200",
    m.current_usage_count AS "Current Usage Count:Int:200",
    m.maximum_usage_count AS "Total Shots:Int:200",
    m.last_maintenance_date AS "Last Maintenance Date:Date:190",
    m.next_maintenance_due AS "Next Maintenance Date:Date:190"
FROM
    `tabMould` m
ORDER BY
    m.name ASC;
